notes: Prices you type are shown as typed. If you type only numbers, the currency you pick is put in front.
Fancy fonts have English letters only. Hindi and other scripts use a plain system font and look different on each phone.
Large catalogues with many big photos can be slow on an old phone. Photos are reduced to a size that is enough for print.
